name: Lover's Diary
source:
Rowan spends too much time on his computer. Rowan loves cockroaches. Rowan doesn't talk to people. 

Rowan loves Haushinka. But he can't have her. So he writes about her in his diary. He paints beautiful pictures in the dark.

Rowan hates Trent. Trent finds Rowan's diary. Now everyone knows what Rowan does when he's alone in his bedroom.

Rowan wants Haushinka. Rowan wants revenge.

Lover's Diary is an adult visual novel, and a psychological drama! Experience the mind of a boy not unlike you and me, a boy who will do anything for his love - and perhaps learn a thing or two along the way. 

[From [url=https://freakbunny.itch.io/lovers-diary]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
罗文在电脑上花费了太多时间。罗文喜欢蟑螂。罗文不与人说话。

罗文喜欢豪辛卡。但他不能拥有她。所以他在日记里写下了她的事。他在黑暗中画出美丽的图画。

罗文讨厌特伦特。特伦特找到了罗文的日记。现在每个人都知道罗文独自一人在卧室时会做什么。

罗文想要豪辛卡。罗文想要报仇。

情人日记是一部成人视觉小说，也是一部心理剧！体验一个男孩的思想，就像你我一样，一个为了自己的爱愿意做任何事的男孩——也许在这个过程中会学到一两件事。

[来自[url=https://freakbunny.itch.io/lovers-diary]Itch.io[/url]]
